run_command: python solution/main.py doctor --input input && python solution/main.py train --input input --output output && python solution/main.py transcribe --checkpoint output/checkpoint --input input/validation.jsonl --output output/transcripts.jsonl
notes: Fixed a shadowing bug: inside cmd_train the output-directory value was named `out` and was then overwritten in the training loop by the model's forward result (`Seq2SeqLMOutput`), so the later `os.makedirs(out, ...)` raised `TypeError: expected str, bytes or os.PathLike object, not Seq2SeqLMOutput`. Renamed the directory variable to `out_dir` and the forward result to `model_out` / `eval_loss` so no path ever points at a tensor/model object. No other behaviour changed: doctor still returns 78 on missing file/dep/CUDA and 0 otherwise; train still runs real CUDA teacher-forced fp32 Whisper-tiny updates on all 16 recordings (coverage 4 optimizer steps covering every id), saves the reloadable HF checkpoint + processor, optimizer/LR/RNG state, and run.json with loss/coverage/truncation/timings/checks + train WER; transcribe greedily decodes all 8 validation recordings to transcripts.jsonl (id/text/token_ids/duration). Validation WER remains null because validation.jsonl has no reference transcripts (debug variant only; not the reference-large contract).
